claim_text: Some studies report performance effects of beta-alanine in repeated high-intensity efforts, but applicability depends on exercise duration, protocol and outcome; this does not support a generic recommendation for all sports.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported supplementation and support context-specific evidence interpretation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food sources and relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet reviews beta-alanine evidence and protocol-specific findings.
limitations: Paresthesia and protocol-specific uncertainty require safety review; no dose from this claim.
Underlying evidence and exact source passages require full appraisal before approval.
